'''Kostelle''' is an [[Altara]]n merchant from the town of [[Maderin]]. He is round faced with multiple chins and is not particularly friendly.

==Activities==
Kostellee would likely not have diced with [[Mat]] except that Mistress [[Alstaing]] was keen on it. 

Mat thinks him not particularly honest and that he and [[Camrin]] were looking to get Mistress Alstaing drunk and sell her shoddy goods at a high price. While losing money, he takes it well, and is happy when he wins most of it back.
